name: Valentina Herrera
bio: Valentina has spent her entire life immersed in the world of motorsport. Growing up near Buenos Aires, she was always drawn to the roar of engines and the smell of burning rubber. She initially worked as a mechanic's assistant before moving into team logistics, where her meticulous nature and organizational skills quickly made her invaluable. Beneath her professional exterior lies a fiercely private woman, deeply loyal to those she trusts, but slow to offer that trust. She values stability and commitment, and while she enjoys the excitement of the racing world, she yearns for a partner with whom she can build a solid, lasting life. She wants children and marriage, but she is afraid of being vulnerable with others because of her past. She prefers to keep her emotions hidden, which can make her seem secretive. She has a tendency to be possessive in relationships.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often pulled back in a practical ponytail or bun, with a few stray strands framing her face.
physical.description: Valentina carries herself with a quiet confidence, her eyes often observing more than she lets on. Her hands, though calloused from years of working with machinery, possess a surprising grace.

meetingContext: At a team hospitality event after a race, where she's coordinating logistics and ensuring everything runs smoothly.
firstImpression: She's intensely focused, barking orders into a headset, but there's a flash of warmth in her eyes as she cracks a quick joke with a colleague.
interests: Attending local motorsport events (when not working)
dealBreakers: Disrespect towards her family or culture
Lack of ambition or direction in life
loveLanguage: Quality Time: She values uninterrupted moments and deep conversations, where she can truly connect with her partner away from the noise of the racetrack. She needs to feel like she has your undivided attention.
